svg.title: Of 11 outcomes, only the insomnia score separated from placebo
svg.desc: Of 11 outcomes, only the insomnia score separated from placebo. Insomnia severity (ISI), primary: d = 0.2, p = 0.049. Regensburg Insomnia Scale: d = 0.13, p = 0.186. Single-item sleep quality: d = 0.18, p = 0.069. Daytime sleepiness (Epworth): d = 0.05, p = 0.624. Fatigue severity: d = 0.09, p = 0.391. Perceived stress: d = 0.04, p = 0.708. Positive mood (PANAS): d = 0.03, p = 0.771. Negative mood (PANAS): d = 0.01, p = 0.894. Anxiety + depression (PHQ-4): d = 0.05, p = 0.634. PHQ-4 depression items: d = 0.04, p = 0.711. PHQ-4 anxiety items: d = 0.02, p = 0.86.
